'''Jimit Trivedi''' is an Indian actor, who has performed in Hindi and Gujarati cinema, television and theatre.

==Career==
Jimit Trivedi debuted in [[Bollywood]] films in 2007 with ''[[Bhool Bhulaiya]]'', starring [[Akshay Kumar]]. His debut in [[Gujarati film]]s was in 2015 with a lead role in the commercially successful film ''[[Gujjubhai The Great]]'', alongside [[Siddharth Randeria]]. He is also the leading character in the movie's sequel, ''[[GujjuBhai - Most Wanted]]''.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tv/news/hindi/Theatres-my-first-love-says-Jimit-Trivedi/articleshow/12836681.cms|title=Theatre's my first love, says Jimit Trivedi - Times of India|work=The Times of India|access-date=2018-02-09}}</ref>
Jimit was also the lead role in the Gujarati film ''[[Polam Pol]]''. He played a supporting role in the 2018 Bollywood film ''[[102 Not Out]]'' starring  [[Amitabh Bachchan]] and the late [[Rishi Kapoor]].<ref name="toi1">{{Cite news|url=http://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/bollywood/jimit-trivedi-an-actor-to-watch-out-for-rishi-kapoor-4663578/|title=Jimit Trivedi, an actor to watch out for : Rishi Kapoor|date=2017-05-19|work=The Indian Express|access-date=2018-02-09|language=en-US}}</ref>

Trivedi is also into Hindi television shows. He was a part of various daily soaps. In ''[[Ek Doosre Se Karte Hain Pyaar Hum]]'' he played a small but significant role.
